b0b.dev - the intro film

A short film in eight parts that cuts archive footage against the present: newsreel and government film from 1945 to 1987 beside the cameras, data centres, launches, crowds and hearings of the years since. Every panel carries its source, burned into the frame. Archive footage is public domain or CC0; contemporary stills are public domain, CC0 or CC BY, with the author credit on screen as the licence requires. Frames marked ERC-1155 are from the author’s own films. The narration is part of the file, spoken by the Piper “cori” voice (UK English, trained on public-domain LibriVox recordings); under it are the archive films’ own sound and a bed made for this film. Nothing licensed from anyone runs under the narration.

Download the film (MP4, 1280×720, subtitles burned in).
